Title: Credit Card Payoff Calculator: How Long Will It Take?
Description: Paying only the minimum on a $5,000 card at 22% APR takes over 19 years and costs about $8,100 in interest. A fixed $250 a month clears it in 26 months. See your own payoff date and interest, free, no sign-up.

Title: Debt Snowball vs Avalanche Calculator (Free)
Description: Snowball pays the smallest balance first; avalanche pays the highest interest rate first. Enter your own debts to see your debt-free date, total interest, and payoff order under both methods. Free, no sign-up, nothing leaves your browser.

Title: 2026 Quarterly Estimated Tax Due Dates for Freelancers
Description: The fourth 2026 estimated tax payment is due January 15, 2027. Self-employed people usually need to pay quarterly if they expect to owe $1,000 or more. The free calculator works out your payment with the IRS 1040-ES worksheet and safe harbor rules.

Title: How Much to Set Aside for Taxes as a Freelancer (2026)
Description: With no other income, a single freelancer with $60,000 of 2026 profit owes about $12,037 in federal income and self-employment tax, roughly 20%. Use the free calculator to get your own quarterly estimated tax payment, based on the IRS Form 1040-ES worksheet.
